about: The "member as of date" template policy (derived_card_revocation_propagation.md §10; step 6.5a, option D). The same `derive` program and shape as `policy.json`: the card shows membership as of its `issued_at`, and the source issuer can end it only by a fraud revocation (9xx), not by ending the source card for any other reason. It lapses at `expires_at`, at most 90 days after issue. Governance registers it (RegisterPolicy) and replaces the placeholder `program_cid`.

field_definitions.name: source_policy
field_definitions.description: The policy the presented source card was issued under

field_definitions.name: projected
field_definitions.description: RFC 8785 JSON of the source card's projected fields, under their source names, values verbatim

field_definitions.name: dup_tag
field_definitions.description: HMAC-SHA256 under the template key for the period: equal for any two cards derived from the same source card in one period

input_schema.name: derived_recipient_pubkey
input_schema.description: The holder's fresh key for the derived card (ML-DSA-44, 1312 bytes)

input_schema.name: target_period
input_schema.description: The period index the card is for: the current one, or the next inside the renewal window

parameter_bounds.name: source_policy
parameter_bounds.description: The policy whose cards may be presented

parameter_bounds.name: projected_fields
parameter_bounds.description: Names of source-card fields to copy, at most three. Empty is a bare membership claim, which the source issuer can't veto (6.5a)
